newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Student protesters face Belgrade riot police.
newsitem.headline: Student protesters face Belgrade riot police.

text.p: Some 40,000 Belgrade students on Friday faced a cordon of riot police in a tense city centre stand-off and blocked a bridge to protest against alleged election fraud by ruling Socialists, witnesses said.
The students are taking part in 33 days of protests over alleged vote-rigging which overturned opposition victories in 15 of Serbia's biggest towns, including the capital.
Belgrade student leaders had promised to mobilise their supporters to blockade three bridges over the Sava River on Friday with the aim of paralysing Belgrade for 30 minutes.
A group of some 25,000 students left the main body facing the police and was heading towards the direction of a second bridge, reporters said.
The students put out a cord between themselves and the police to calm the situation but a crowd of elder bystanders started protesting and hurling insults against the police, they added.
